'''Circusci Cus''' was a building in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Cliffhold/Legends|Cliffhold]] on [[Iego/Legends|Iego]]. It was decorated with purple marquees written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]], which stated the name of the establishment.
